q: 1. The chart which gives an estimate about the amount of materials handling between various workstation is known as
explain: A travel chart tabulates the quantity of material moved between workstations, so it is used to analyse material handling.

q: 2. During storage of cement, the bag of cement should be kept......cm apart from the walls.
explain: Standard site storage specifications mandate keeping cement stacks at least 30 cm (12 inches) away from exterior walls to prevent moisture absorption from walls.

q: 3. For excavating solid rocks, the most suitable equipment is
explain: The answer key gives hoe (d). Note: many textbooks name the power shovel for blasted rock.

q: 4. Which one of the following does not form a part of Derrick crane?
explain: A derrick crane consists of a mast, boom and guy ropes; a jack is not part of it.

q: 5. The handling of materials in the construction of a multistoreyed building will require for lifting
explain: Vertical lifting of materials in multistoreyed buildings is done by hoists.

q: 6. Which of the following equipments is not used for hauling
explain: Per the answer key, d (scrapers). Note: a dragline is an excavator, so many books give c.

q: 7. The effectiveness of explosion during increases by the process of
explain: Stemming (packing the hole above the charge) confines the blast and raises its effectiveness.

q: 8. A golden rule for the procurement of construction stores, suggests
options: 67% at the site and 33% under procurement
50% at the site and 50% under procurement
33% at the site and 67% under procurement
explain: The conventional guideline for stores management suggests keeping about two-thirds (67%) of material at site and one-third (33%) in the procurement pipeline.

q: 9. The most suitable type of equipment for compaction of cohesive soils is
explain: Sheep foot rollers knead and compact clayey (cohesive) soils.

q: 10. Which of the following surfaces will give highest rolling resistance for a rubber tyred vehicle?
explain: Tyres sink into loose sand, giving the highest rolling resistance.

q: 11. A golden rule for the procurement of construction stores is that
options: half of the construction stores should be at work site and half under procurement
two-third of the construction stores should be at work site and one-third under procurement
three-fourth of the construction stores should be at work site and one-fourth under procurement
whole of the construction store should be at work site
explain: Per the answer key, two-thirds at site and one-third under procurement.

q: 12. Weight-batching proceeds on
options: the assumption of the declared weight in each bag of cement
weighing the contents of each bag
accurately estimating the weight of each material to be used in each batch
the assumption of correct dry weight of each size range of each material and the weight of water
explain: Per the answer key, c: the weight of each material for a batch is estimated and weighed accurately.

q: 13. The chart which gives an estimate about the amount of materials handling between various work stations is known as :
explain: A travel chart is used to analyze the movement of materials and personnel between different locations.

q: 14. The pump suitable for high discharge pressure
explain: Reciprocating pumps develop high discharge pressure.

q: 15. Screw pumps are used for pumping
explain: Screw pumps handle highly viscous liquids.

q: 16. Which information has least hearing on the selection of the pump?
options: Nature of liquid to be handled
explain: Capacity, liquid nature and suction lift directly govern pump choice. The end use matters least.

q: 17. Which of the following earth moving machines has the shortest cycle time?
explain: A dipper (power) shovel has the shortest cycle time.

q: 18. For which of the following materials, the output of power shovels for a fixed shovel size will be maximum
explain: Per the answer key, moist loam, which digs easily and fills the dipper well.

q: 19. Which of the following excavators is most suitable for digging under water?
explain: Per the answer key, dragline. Note: many books give clamshell.

q: 20. Which of the following method of procurement is not applicable for material management?
explain: Cost and quality based selection (QCBS) is used for consultancy service selection, not for procurement of materials/goods.

q: 21. The object of technical drawing is
explain: Technical drawings provide dimensions and details necessary for estimate preparation, material take-offs, and resource procurement.

q: 22. The purpose of preparing job-layout for a construction project is :
options: reduction in wastage and deterioration of materials
higher productivity from labour and machinery
explain: Proper site layout optimizes material flow, safety, and efficiency.

q: 23. A golden rule for the procurement of goods, suggests
options: 67% at the site and 33% under procurement
50% at the site and 50% under procurement
33% at the site and 67% under procurement
explain: This ratio balances immediate availability with ongoing supply chain management to avoid storage issues.

q: 24. A drill most suitable for drilling down, horizontal, or up holes is
explain: Per the answer key, drifter.

q: 25. Which of the following mode of selection is related to procurement of goods?
explain: CBS (Cost-Based Selection) is the mode typically associated with procurement of goods, distinct from consultant selection methods like QCBS/QBS.

q: 26. Which of the following method of procurement isn't applicable for material management?
explain: QCBS (Quality and Cost Based Selection) is used for consultant selection, not applicable for material/goods procurement.

q: 27. During storage of cement, the bag of cement should be kept-----------cm apart from the walls.
explain: Cement bags are kept 30 cm away from walls to prevent moisture from the walls from being absorbed into the cement, which would cause it to set prematurely.

q: 28. Sand is produced by crushing in
explain: Per the answer key, ball mill.

q: 29. When quarry rock is to be hauled, the body of a rear dump truck should be
options: deep with vertical or sloping side boards
explain: Per the answer key, shallow with sloping side boards.

q: 30. Bottom dump wagons are not suitable for
explain: Sticky lumps of wet clay do not discharge freely.

q: 31. The most suitable equipment for excavating trenches when the sides are permitted to establish their angles of repose, without shoring is
explain: Per the answer key, dragline, which digs trenches with sloping sides.

q: 32. Which of the following method of procurement is not applicable for material management?
explain: Cost and Quality Based Selection (QCBS) is a consultant-selection method, not applicable to material/goods procurement.

q: 33. Ratio analysis of a construction firm is used for analysis by:
explain: Ratio analysis is fundamentally a tool of financial analysis, used to assess a firm's financial health and performance.
